assumptions.notes: Illustrative research assumptions; ordinary matched same-day share round trips only. Personal tax, data fees and operating costs excluded.

caveats: Illustrative screening assumptions; thresholds are not statistical laws or a personal risk mandate.
Circular block intervals are approximate conditional estimates, not probabilities of future profit.
Inference screening requires blocks shorter than the sample and at least 10 expected bootstrap draws per adjusted tail; these checks do not establish stability or adequate dependence modeling.
Family correction covers the recorded bounded search only; adaptive searches and regime changes remain risks.
Historical drawdown does not cap future loss; bar execution approximations can miss real costs.
A subsequent frozen prospective paper evaluation is required. This version never authorizes live trading.
evidence.drawdown_warning: Reported drawdown uses daily ending equity; it does not bound intraday or future losses.
evidence.execution_warning: Minute-bar and quote-snapshot fills are approximations; queue, depth and transient spread behavior are not reproduced.
failed_checks: trades missing, nonfinite or below 30
net_return must be finite and strictly positive
bootstrap lower bound must be strictly above min_mean_daily_return
Real-data provenance has not been independently verified
Synthetic observations cannot establish a qualifying trading strategy

metrics.annualization: Approximate 252-session convention; extrapolation, not a forecast.

bootstrap_ci.assumptions: Approximate; stable returns and adequate block length for dependence. Not a future-profit probability.
bootstrap_ci.inference_policy: Screening checks only: block_length < n_observations and at least 10 expected bootstrap draws per adjusted tail. Passing is not proof of statistical validity.

metrics.multiple_testing_adjustment: Approximate Bonferroni alpha/family_size for the recorded bounded family. Does not protect against unrecorded or adaptive searches.

notes: Holdout data was structurally audited but no holdout features or performance were used for development.
Daily equity carries across evaluation folds; each session ends flat.
Fixed-horizon regression targets do not include the simulator stop policy.
No-trade nominal cash reference is 0%; cash interest, personal taxes, data and operating fees excluded.
Bootstrap intervals are approximate screening diagnostics, not a probability of future profit.
